json — JSON encoder and decoder¶

Source code: Lib/json/__init__.py

JSON (JavaScript Object Notation) is a lightweight data interchange format. See also pickle — Python object serialization and marshal.

>>> import json
>>> json.dumps(['foo', {'bar': ('baz', None, 1.0, 2)}])

Basic Usage¶

json.dump(obj, fp)

Serialize obj as a JSON formatted stream to fp. Parameters: obj, fp. Raises TypeError.

json.dumps(obj)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted str. Returns a str.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

Encoders and Decoders¶

class json.JSONDecoder

Simple JSON decoder. Methods: decode.

decode(s)

Return the Python representation of s.
